skill_name: Cut the following paragraph about renewable energy into 5 concise sentences.
workflow: Renewable energy is energy generated from natural processes like sunlight, wind, tides, and geothermal heat. It is renewable and not free or infinite, but is plentiful compared to conventional sources. Renewable energy helps to reduce environmental damage, greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution. It is an important part of a low carbon, clean energy system and is fundamental to achieving energy security and sustainable development.
